rows.ambiguity: Both the official issuer IR site and an independent BioSpace mirror display '7:00 AM' with no explicit timezone label (unlike the OCUL and BIIB releases, which showed an explicit UTC or ET marker). Resolved as America/New_York on the strength of two independent sources agreeing on the same clock time, BeiGene's Nasdaq-primary US listing, and the near-universal 07:00-08:00 ET pre-market pattern seen across every other timestamped release in this cohort; flagged EXACT_TO_MINUTE_TIMEZONE_INFERRED rather than plain EXACT_TO_MINUTE because no source explicitly labeled the timezone. The corresponding SEC 8-K was filed 2022-10-14, two days after the release, so it cannot corroborate the exact time.
